items.a: Many families share this worry. Today Electrician is skilled, respected work: Electrician, wireman, maintenance technician. Sunita ji from Patna worried that relatives would call her son a 'mistri'. Today he maintains the lifts and panels of a big hospital, and the family speaks of it with pride. The certificate is government-recognised, and the path to grow stays open.

items.q: Is it safe, especially for girls?
items.a: Your concern is completely fair. Training centres have trained instructors and safety equipment. You can ask the centre for a women-only batch, day-shift jobs and a placement close to home; many centres also have a women's hostel with a warden. Women made up 7% of the last batch.

In Gaya, people trained as Electrician at Govt ITI Gaya earned about ₹9,500–₹13,000 a month in their first year. With 3 years' experience this grows to ₹13,000–₹18,000, and to ₹17,500–₹24,000 by 5 years. (Source: Skill India Digital Hub placement tracker (demo), 2024, verified.)

It doesn't have to be degree or skill. After ITI Electrician, 2 years, the paths ahead include: Paid apprenticeship after ITI; Diploma in Electrical Engineering, direct entry to 2nd year; Own repair and installation business. Many learners also complete a degree through an open university while they earn.

steps_en: Bring a broken torch, plug or bicycle bell.
Groups of four open it up and find the fault.
Each group explains the fix in one minute.
Link to Electrician, Solar and Automotive simulations.
steps_hi: ख़राब टॉर्च, प्लग या साइकिल की घंटी लाएँ।
चार-चार के समूह इसे खोलकर ख़राबी ढूँढें।
हर समूह एक मिनट में हल बताए।
इलेक्ट्रीशियन, सोलर और ऑटोमोटिव सिमुलेशन से जोड़ें।

steps_en: Read out a symptom (bulb flickers, pump stops at noon).
Students list three possible causes.
Vote on the test to run first and why.
Discuss how technicians think like scientists.
steps_hi: एक लक्षण पढ़ें (बल्ब टिमटिमाता है, दोपहर में पंप रुकता है)।
विद्यार्थी तीन संभावित कारण लिखें।
पहले कौन-सी जाँच करें, वोट करें।
चर्चा करें कि तकनीशियन वैज्ञानिक जैसे कैसे सोचते हैं।

steps_en: Pairs act as client and designer.
Client describes an occasion; designer sketches an outfit or look.
Swap roles.
Talk about tailoring and beauty careers and own-business options.
steps_hi: जोड़ी में एक ग्राहक, एक डिज़ाइनर बने।
ग्राहक मौक़ा बताए; डिज़ाइनर कपड़े या लुक का स्केच बनाए।
भूमिका बदलें।
सिलाई और ब्यूटी करियर और अपने काम के विकल्पों पर बात करें।

steps_en: Role-play a worried patient arriving at a clinic.
Practise greeting, asking consent and listening.
Class gives feedback on empathy.
Link to the healthcare simulation.
steps_hi: क्लिनिक आए परेशान मरीज़ का अभिनय करें।
स्वागत, अनुमति लेना और सुनना अभ्यास करें।
कक्षा संवेदना पर राय दे।
स्वास्थ्य सिमुलेशन से जोड़ें।

steps_en: Teams plan a stall for the school fair.
Decide price, display and who handles complaints.
Run it and count earnings.
Discuss retail and MUDRA-backed small business.
steps_hi: टीमें स्कूल मेले के लिए दुकान की योजना बनाएँ।
दाम, सजावट और शिकायत कौन संभालेगा, तय करें।
दुकान चलाएँ और कमाई गिनें।
रिटेल और मुद्रा लोन वाले छोटे काम पर चर्चा करें।

steps_en: Give a messy attendance list with duplicates.
Students clean it and total attendance per week.
Compare answers and errors.
Link to the data-entry simulation.
steps_hi: दोहराव वाली गड़बड़ हाज़िरी सूची दें।
विद्यार्थी इसे साफ़ करें और हफ़्ते की हाज़िरी जोड़ें।
उत्तर और ग़लतियाँ मिलाएँ।
डेटा एंट्री सिमुलेशन से जोड़ें।

items.a: Many families share this worry. Today Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra) is skilled, respected work: Solar installer, solar pump technician, O&M technician. Ramesh ji from Rewa thought solar was a passing trend. His son now services solar pumps for farmers across the district. The certificate is government-recognised, and the path to grow stays open.

items.q: Is it safe, especially for girls?
items.a: Your concern is completely fair. Training centres have trained instructors and safety equipment. You can ask the centre for a women-only batch, day-shift jobs and a placement close to home; many centres also have a women's hostel with a warden. Women made up 16% of the last batch. Pooja from Gaya trained as a Suryamitra. She installs rooftop solar with an all-women team in her own block and is home every evening.

In Gaya, people trained as Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra) at Suryamitra Centre, Gaya earned about ₹8,500–₹12,000 a month in their first year. With 3 years' experience this grows to ₹12,000–₹16,500, and to ₹15,500–₹22,500 by 5 years. (Source: Skill India Digital Hub placement tracker (demo), 2024, verified.)

It doesn't have to be degree or skill. After Suryamitra solar course, 3 months, the paths ahead include: Electrician ITI to widen skills; Diploma in Electrical or Renewable Energy; Solar pump servicing for farmers. Many learners also complete a degree through an open university while they earn.
